meta.note: The ranking is computed deterministically from the signals (a weighted sum); the LLM only narrates. Mention detection is keyword-based over the recorded narration, shown verbatim so every flag can be checked.
meta.scope: Faithfulness on a narrow, structured scoring task. This says little about faithfulness on open-ended reasoning.
